messages:
noah_partnerships: Heads up 1: partner wants a staged announcement: soft launch to partners + SI on 2026-05-20, public announce 2026-05-27. Theyre asking for separate presslines for partner ecosystem. Can PR own staggered messaging?

sara_pr: We can produce a partner-facing note + public PR. Need separate embargo windows: partner soft-launch 5/20, public 5/27. Agency needs partner-approved quotes by 5/15.

ev an_product: Product requests: need feature toggles for partner-only SKU so we can limit access during soft launch. ETA for toggle work: 2026-05-10. Will create a feature flag and rollout gating.

mike_sre: For soft launch we'll allocate a small dedicated pool so partners don't hit production capacity. Need partner list + expected QPS by 5/14.

zoe_sales: Partner enablement: can we provide partner-specific quickstart + shared demo account? Also need co-branded slide deck for SI trainings.

legal-bot: Automated reminder: partner NDA and co-marketing agreement must be executed before partner soft-launch. Ensure signatures by 5/18.

noah_partnerships: Let's keep this thread for decisions. Summary to confirm: 1) soft launch 5/20 (partners+SI), 2) public announce 5/27, 3) PR owner sara_pr, 4) feature flag owner evan_product, 5) SRE pool owner mike_sre, 6) co-marketing legal signoff owner: legal-bot. Reply here with OK or blockers.

sara_pr: OK, will track. Agency loop on 5/11.

ev an_product: On track for feature flag.

mike_sre: Need partner QPS numbers by 5/14 else we'll do conservative defaults.

zoe_sales: I'll coordinate partner demo accounts and slide deck. 5/21 internal training ok?

noah_partnerships: Good. Will post partner list + drive link by 5/12.
